name: openWakeWord hey jarvis
summary: Wake-word model that scores 80 ms frames of 16 kHz mono audio for the spoken phrase "hey jarvis", run through openWakeWord's ONNX pipeline.

license.notes: Non-commercial only: the upstream repository's LICENSE file is Apache-2.0 but that covers the code, and openWakeWord's README licenses all included pre-trained models, this one among them, under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0.

notes: All three ONNX artifacts are required together: melspectrogram.onnx and embedding_model.onnx are openWakeWord's shared preprocessor and must be passed as melspec_model_path / embedding_model_path; openWakeWord otherwise resolves them inside its own package directory (openwakeword/resources/models/) and raises ONNXRuntimeError NO_SUCHFILE rather than fetching anything - the download only happens on an explicit openwakeword.utils.download_models() call. Vetted 2026-07-28 on Linux x86_64 with openwakeword 0.6.0 + onnxruntime 1.28.0. The .tflite variants of the same release are deliberately not cataloged: they were not exercised here.
